objective: Reduce shared-account ownership transfers in unchanged funded hash-map loops while preserving exact original batch sizes, debits and all finite parent/local limits.
mechanism: Reserve up to 64 identical paired batch prices from the existing group escrow. An atomic batch count commits both u64 dimensions together; large work prices are never truncated or independently committed.
Use one 128-byte-aligned atomic slot per eligible worker, up to the existing native task cap of 32. Both registry and aligned Arc allocation backing are admitted before construction.

A full debit requires four remaining original batch prices in both the worker-local limit and its exclusive credit. Keep 1024 original visits; keep synchronized selection near limits, changed/unsupported prices and overflow.
Seal and fold successful atomic batch counts when revoking, changing price, retiring or closing a group. Release only unspent reservation. Recover idle peer credit before any checked global denial.
Retain source/bytecode/resources, complete maps, default growth, original update counts, seven workers, secured startup/shutdown and OS settings.
qualification: Large paired prices and no repeated escrow lock in the admitted steady region.

Idle-peer and direct-debit reclamation, near limits and call scopes, both-dimension atomicity, exact remaining observations, price changes, early close/races, panic/cancellation retention, memory cleanup and excess-slot fallback.
Full native and catalog qualification; frozen source snapshots and terminal receipts for all attempts.
measurement: Two predeclared balanced full-input sessions against the independently retained parent and exact upstream Rust; no excluded full-input observations. Require runtime credit-selection counters. Exact-code profiles and counter/memory/size diagnostics remain separate.
